name: brainygym
description: Turn what you learn with your AI into courses with spaced-repetition reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Remember what you learn with AI
interface.longDescription: Design courses with your AI and train them in BrainyGym with spaced-repetition reviews. Turn a coding session or a codebase into a short course, quiz yourself, and keep reviewing on the web and the mobile app.
defaultPrompt: Turn what we just did in this session into a BrainyGym course.
Help me learn this codebase with a BrainyGym course.
What do I need to review today in BrainyGym?
